name: Hyung Shim
bio: is a third year student at the Law School. Like actually. He traveled through Newark International Airport this past summer for the method.

name: Matias Rojas
bio: is a third-year Theater and Performance Studies and English Language and Literature double major. This is his first University Theater show, and so he's eternally grateful to his two wonderful castmates and the whole production team for making it an amazing and collaborative experience. He'd like to send out special thanks to his director Lucy for convincing him to audition. Shoutout Newark, NJ! Couldn't *sniffle* . . . couldn't do it *wipes away tear* . . . couldn't do it without you *incoherent sobbing*.

name: Melanie Zhang
bio: is a fourth-year TAPS; Law, Letters, and Society; and Comparative Literature major. Previous credits include Happy Birthday Mars Rover (Mars Rover) and Red Rex (Tori). She wants to give her sincerest thanks to Lucy, the crew of Sanctuary City, and her friends who have been the most enthusiastic supporters through it all. As for her thoughts on Newark, New Jersey, she thinks it's the epicenter of the world, a place that is both the end and the beginning. She could not have envisioned a better way to complete her college theater experience, and she hopes you enjoy the show as much as she does!
